jobsByAverageDelta.title: AI Product Intern (B2C & User Growth) - ScamAdviser
Solutions Architect, Hunter - Digital Native Business
Senior Engineering Manager for Workspace Platform

featureDifferences.app: 職業分析 app 的 tracker 上限是 1000 筆 jobs；此 snapshot 會匯入 1000 筆，其中 1000 筆 active。
featureDifferences.careerOps: Career Ops 後端可直接跑 profile corpus x job snapshot；本次跑 1000 profiles x 6232 active jobs。
featureDifferences.difference: app 適合互動式追蹤與人工檢視；career-ops 適合批次、可重跑、可稽核的大量比對。

featureDifferences.app: 本機 app 引擎只評分描述足夠的 active jobs，本次 880/1000 筆可重算。
featureDifferences.careerOps: 後端 deterministic scorer 本次評估 6232 筆 active jobs。
featureDifferences.difference: 5352 筆 active jobs 在後端有分數，但 app 本機引擎因 JD 太短或只有 URL 而不重算。

featureDifferences.app: app 匯入 Career Ops profile 時會保留原始結構化 profile；本機引擎優先使用 preferences、skillExperience、proofPoints、starStories，再以 14 個 CV 欄位 fallback。
featureDifferences.careerOps: 後端保留 structured profile 欄位，例如 preferences、proofPoints、starStories、skillExperience、work authorization、compensation anchors。
featureDifferences.difference: 結構化 profile 的評分已高度還原後端；純手填 CV 欄位仍會是較輕量的 projection 模式。

featureDifferences.app: browser-local 6D + Block G，支援互動式重算、localStorage/cloud tracker、客製 PDF 和 optional AI 評估。
featureDifferences.careerOps: CLI pipeline 產生 jobs、quality gate、intelligence、deep research、compensation、story bank、parallel report、decision report 等 artifacts。
featureDifferences.difference: app 是前台操作面，career-ops 是資料管線與報告層；兩者分數接近時可互補，分歧時通常來自資料結構與 coverage。

featureDifferences.app: app 額外把泛用 careers/jobs 首頁 URL 視為 caution signal。
featureDifferences.careerOps: 後端 Block G 使用 ATS domain、日期、描述長度、紅黃旗關鍵字等 deterministic checks。
featureDifferences.difference: 泛用公司職涯頁在 app 可能比後端更保守。

notes: App comparison mimics the browser-local CV Studio Career Ops engine after the structured profile parity upgrade.
When a Career Ops profile is imported, the app now keeps the original structured profile and uses it before falling back to CV fields.
Backend comparison uses the structured Career Ops profile normalization and deterministic scorer.
The app can still display backend-imported scores for jobs it does not locally re-score.
